description: Implement individual-row validation beside the CSV reader, budgeting approximately 50 implementation lines and 50 test lines. Reject wrong column counts, unknown tag types, invalid/nonfinite times, negative starts, and ends not greater than starts. Leave blank-record filtering, duplicate detection, row limits, endpoint wiring, and UI for later slices. Run focused tests and the existing pytest suite.

Focused tests cover column count, exact trimmed tag names, finite ordered times, optional text, and unique player resolution.
